title: Lantern Glow
theme: A tiny clockwork firefly grows a glowing lantern in a mossy hollow.
mechanics: Tap or click the firefly to send water to its shell
Collect drifting light motes for energy
Grow the firefly through four lantern stages
Reach the radiant bloom to win

controls.action: Tap or click the firefly to water it
Tap or click a light mote to collect ene
